Read Order

When a task affects this vault, agents should read the bootstrap file, then the charter, then the relevant MOC. Links that point at notes which do not exist yet, like Review Cadence, are marked as gaps.

  1. Agent Session Instructions
  2. Vault Charter
  3. Concept Types and Status Vocabulary when creating or changing frontmatter.
  4. The specific project, area, or resource notes being changed

Core Structure

Every layer of PARA maps to one MOC. The left column is the label in nearly every table here, so it carries more weight.

LayerUseLink
ProjectsActive outcomes with a finish lineProjects MOC
AreasOngoing responsibilities and standardsAreas MOC
ResourcesReusable material and referencesResources MOC
SystemRules for humans and agentsVault Charter

Placement rules

Place it by PARA. How-tos, methods and references go to 3-Resources/. Ambiguous captures land in 0-Inbox/ flagged for review, and are never left unlinked.

Edge cases

Creation: prefer extending an existing note over creating a near-duplicate. Move: record the superseded decision in the collection log.

Do not rely on hidden chat context when a note should preserve it. A small linked note beats lost knowledge.

Verification

Run the conformance checks after adding, moving, or renaming notes:

pwsh -NoProfile -File tools/Invoke-OkfChecks.ps1 -FixIndexes
pwsh -NoProfile -File tools/Invoke-OkfChecks.ps1
type: System
title: Agent Operating Protocol
tags: [system, agents, protocol, handoff]
  • Generated indexes are current
  • Concepts linked from at least one MOC
  • Frontmatter types match the vocabulary
Handoff

Create a handoff when the work is unfinished or the reasoning is not obvious from the changed files.
